photos.caption: A little sunshine, a favourite jacket.

photos.caption: Sea air, warm layers, no hurry.

photos.caption: Where the sky meets a quieter day.
photos.alt: Maria standing beside gentle waves beneath a softly glowing, cloud-filled sky.

photos.caption: A splash of colour by the waves.

photos.caption: Comfort is always in style.

photos.caption: Lilac, softness, and a little everyday joy.

photos.caption: Checks, pearls, and a little confidence.

photos.caption: One favourite piece, a fresh little pairing.

photos.caption: The little details behind the outfit.
photos.alt: A checked top, matching shorts and a white textured top arranged on a quilted bedspread.

photos.caption: Barefoot moments and an endless blue.
photos.alt: Maria on the sand beside the sea, wearing a straw hat, white sweatshirt and light shorts.

photos.caption: A smile, a little red, a moment of me.
